result: If I could change one thing, I’d help people listen to each other with more patience and less fear. So many problems grow because we stop seeing the person across from us as human. Better understanding would not erase disagreement, but it would make compromise possible, kindness easier, and cruelty harder. That feels like a change that could ripple into many lives.
